arStrings.szText:
{c_important}Ball Lightning{/c} splashes on impact dealing {c_random}[Affix_Value_1*100|%|]{/c} of its total damage instantly. It Stuns enemies for {c_number}[Affix."Static Value 2"]{/c} second if it reaches its maximum range.

{c_important}Super Ball Lightnings{/c} are larger, deal  {c_number}[Affix."Static Value 4"|%x|]{/c} increased damage, have a higher Lucky Hit Chance, and their Stun duration is increased to {c_number}[Affix."Static Value 3"]{/c} seconds.
